note: Subject index for Aliz Tutor Mode. Every lessonId resolves to res://content/tutor/lessons/<lessonId>.json and every subject lists at least one lesson so the selector never dead-ends. entryLessonId is the menu Aliz opens with (a single choose step); defaultLessonId is where 'anything' / 'I don't know' goes. keywords are what a child says to pick or switch to the subject (choose steps and handle_interjection); a keyword may belong to one subject only.
